verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for locally installed simulation and robotics software like Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab and Isaac ROS, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, data collection or any opt-out setting. The Docker, pip and headless deployment items describe how the software is installed and run, not privacy controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
